info.title: Billit Peppol Send XML API
info.description: Sends a UBL invoice or credit note over the Peppol network through Billit. The endpoint is documented at https://docs.billit.be/docs/peppol-sendxml but is absent from Billit's Swagger document; this file transcribes it so the catalogue holds the interface actually used on 2026-10-21 (run record Y1-Billit-Peppol-send-CS95-BL-1848-2026-10-21).

tags.name: Peppol
tags.description: Peppol network: send and receive documents

post.summary: Send a UBL XML document over Peppol
post.description: Sends one UBL 2.1 document (Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 invoice or credit note) to the receiver named inside the document. The sending party is the company of the API key; the receiver is resolved from the document's AccountingCustomerParty endpoint identifier, which must be registered on Peppol. The whole UBL document is passed as a string in the single field XML. Returns the identifier of the created inbox item.

XML.description: The complete UBL 2.1 XML document (Peppol BIS Billing 3.0 Invoice or CreditNote) as a string, including the XML declaration.

200.description: The document was accepted for sending; the body is the Billit inbox item identifier.

schema.description: InboxItemID of the created send record.

400.description: The document was rejected (for example GenericError when the sending company has no business number, or TheCustomerIsNotActiveOnPeppol when the receiver is not registered).

apiKey.name: apiKey
apiKey.description: API key issued in the Billit sandbox or production account (Settings > API). Optional header partyID selects the company when the key covers several.
